name: NHANES II cervical and lumbar spine films (NCHS, 1976 to 1980)
what: 16,531 digitised cervical and lumbar spine films of the second National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey with no landmarks: the 17,073 films on disk (the CDC's index lists 17,075, two of them empty at the source, L00452 and L00456) less the 542 that nhanes2_annotated labels, whose 543rd, L00452, survives only in its landmarks file
how_to_get: Held: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/nhanes2_cdc_films, downloaded from the CDC's index by a resumable grid job, 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-23; nothing to fetch.

To share it with collaborators, copy it into /rs/rs_grp_oschome/shared/datasets/nhanes2_unannotated/ with its checksums as a Slurm job, as the pig set of #22 was copied, and note the job in the history.
source_status: held on the grid under the owner's data root, as SchwingNet's registry records it on 2026-10-23

history.note: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/nhanes2_cdc_films, downloaded from the CDC's index by a resumable grid job, 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-23, before the shared tree and its promoter existed; the record written for the census (#178) from SchwingNet's registry
